Once I have that, I’ll confirm the exact items on your order and then (after that) I’ll ask you for **explicit “yes” confirmation** to process the **return** and the **exchange**.

Once I have that, I can pull up your orders and then we’ll proceed with the **return** and **exchange** (after your explicit “yes” confirmation).
